question:
The following line graph shows the production of wheat (in tonnes) in India from 2012 to 2017. Study the graph, and answer the question asked.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/443a90c3b10c3811d5d081b8a24247f4db82cbfa8be0221be43806f3f118caa1.png] 

In the year 2018, if the production of wheat decreases by 10% as compared to the previous year, then what will be the difference in the productions (in tonnes) of wheat in the year 2018 and the year 2015?
solution:
**Given:**

Wheat production in 2017 = 9,48,000 tonnes

Wheat production in 2015 = 9,64,000 tonnes

Percentage decrease in wheat production in 2018 = 10%

**Formula used:**

Production in 2018 = Production in 2017 × (1 - Decrease percentage)

Difference in production = Production in 2018 - Production in 2015

**Calculations:**

Production in 2018 = 9,48,000 × (1 - 10/100)

⇒ Production in 2018 = 9,48,000 × 0.9

⇒ Production in 2018 = 8,53,200 tonnes

Difference in production = 9,64,000 - 8,53,200

⇒ Difference in production = 1,10,800 tonnes

∴ The correct answer is option (2) 1,10,800.
